en.headline: MTR opens new Hong Kong-bound track for Tung Chung Line Extension
en.dek: Trains from Tung Chung station began using the new section serving the future Tung Chung East station from the first departure on Sunday; service was smooth and journey times largely unchanged.
body: The MTR Corporation said the new Hong Kong-bound track section that will connect to the future Tung Chung East station on the Tung Chung Line Extension formally entered service on Sunday.

From the first train of the day, services departing Tung Chung station switched to the new alignment. Train frequency remained unchanged and overall journey times were broadly similar to before, the operator said, adding that the service had been smooth and that it would continue to monitor operations closely.

Engineering teams will next begin the corresponding diversion works for the Tung Chung-bound direction. This includes removing sections of the old Hong Kong-bound track that are no longer needed, laying the new track and completing further turnout installations later this year and next year. The Tung Chung Line Extension is targeted for completion in 2029.

zh.headline: 港鐵東涌綫延綫往香港方向新路軌段今日啟用
zh.dek: 接駁未來東涌東站的往香港方向新路軌段周日正式投入服務，由東涌站開出的列車改行新路段，班次不變，行車時間大致相若，服務暢順。
body: 港鐵公司表示，東涌綫延綫項目中接駁東涌東站（暫用名稱）的往香港方向新路軌段，今日正式啟用。
自頭班車起，由東涌站開出的列車開始改行新路段，列車班次維持不變，整體行車時間與之前大致相若，服務大致暢順。港鐵會繼續密切監察運作情況。
工程團隊隨後將開始下一階段往東涌方向的路軌改道工程，包括拆除毋須再行車的部分往香港方向舊路軌，騰出空間鋪設新路軌，以及於今年底及明年進行餘下道岔安裝工序。東涌綫延綫目標於2029年完工。
